proof_required: Named public-health/emergency authority, trigger criteria, order channel, and cancel/stop criteria.
explicit_limit: KI must be taken only when instructed by public-health or emergency officials or a healthcare provider.
failure_to_block: unauthorized public self-dosing or conflicting authority messages

proof_required: Inventory by dose form, expiration/rotation record, storage location, distribution points, access/functional-needs delivery path, and after-hours staffing.
explicit_limit: A stockpile alone is not distribution readiness.
failure_to_block: inventory counted as readiness despite no delivery path to children, pregnant/lactating people, carless households, institutions, or limited-English residents

proof_required: Age/pregnancy/lactation dosing instructions, timing window, repeat-dose instruction, and adverse-effect warning are included in public messages.
explicit_limit: Most effective timing is shortly before or soon after radioactive iodine exposure; not a post-hoc treatment.
failure_to_block: public believes KI reverses exposure or can be taken whenever convenient

proof_required: Scorecard explicitly says KI cannot satisfy evacuation, sheltering, decontamination, population monitoring, food/water controls, hospital readiness, or recovery gates.
explicit_limit: KI protects only the thyroid against radioactive iodine; it does not protect the whole body or against other radioactive materials.
failure_to_block: KI stockpile is used as political theater to mask missing protective-action capacity

proof_required: Contraindications, allergy warnings, infant follow-up, pregnant/lactating instructions, and healthcare referral pathway.
explicit_limit: KI can cause harmful effects and is not recommended for every person in every scenario.
failure_to_block: medical countermeasure causes avoidable harm or excludes high-priority groups

proof_required: KI instructions are embedded with get-inside/stay-tuned, shelter/evacuate, food/water, reception-center, and decontamination instructions.
explicit_limit: KI is supplemental where appropriate, not a standalone protective action.
failure_to_block: people leave shelter or evacuation routes to seek KI at the wrong time

proof_required: Distribution and messaging are tested with language/disability/no-car/institutional populations; failures enter corrective-action backlog.
explicit_limit: An unexercised KI plan remains template evidence.
failure_to_block: known distribution gaps stay hidden behind inventory counts
